label.zh:
要求着陆行星
没有可以接受的合约。

永恒巡游已经结束，旅客们将告别无尽的航程，拥抱土地与天空。

建立定居点以结束此局势。

  帝国效果：
    —将不再是游牧帝国！
    —位于无主星系内的驿站将转化为恒星基地。
    —剩余的方舟将作为附属国释放。

 方舟舰效果：
    —该殖民地已转移至目标行星。
    —方舟将被废弃拆解。

行星效果：
    —增加方舟残骸修正
        —宜居性：+60%
        —最大区划数：+2
label.en:
Planetfall Demanded
No contracts can be accepted.

The Forever Cruise is over, and the passengers will trade endless voyage for soil and sky.

Make a Settlement to conclude the situation.

  Empire Effects: 
    - Will cease to be a Nomadic empire! 
    - Waystations in Unowned Systems will be converted into Starbases. 
    - Remaining Arkships will be released as a Subject. 

  Arkship Effects: 
    - The  Colony is transferred to the target planet. 
    - The Arkship will be abandoned and dismantled. 

  Planet Effects: 
    - Adds the Arkship Remains modifier 
        - Habitability: +60% 
        - Max Districts: +2
